name: Boss Compasses
description: Compasses that find the Twilight Forest boss lairs on the road to the Stellar Core.

pages.title: Boss Compasses
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() One compass for each Twilight boss on the way to the [#](2E5AAC)[Stellar Core](entry://stars/stellar_core)[#]().
- Right-click it in the Twilight Forest: chat shows where the nearest lair is, and the needle points there.
- Each is a Compass plus drops you will have by then.

Structures are spread out in Create Galore, so a lair can be a long walk away. The **Hydra** drops the Fiery Blood the core needs, and the Twilight Forest only lets you reach it after beating the **Naga**, the **Lich** and the **Minoshroom**, in that order. Each of the four has a compass that finds its lair.

pages.title: The four compasses
pages.text:
- **Naga Compass**: finds the Naga Courtyard. Compass, Raven Feather, Torchberries.
- **Lich Compass**: finds the Lich Tower. Compass and 2 Naga Scales.

- **Minoshroom Compass**: finds the Minotaur Labyrinth. Compass and Exanimate Essence, which the Lich drops.
- **Hydra Compass**: finds the Hydra's Lair in the Fire Swamp. Compass, Raw Meef and a Maze Slimeball from the Labyrinth.

pages.title: Using one
pages.text: Right-click it anywhere in the Twilight Forest. Chat shows the X and Z of the nearest lair and how far away it is, and from then on the needle points there, like a lodestone compass. It searches up to 1600 blocks around you.

Right-click again later to search from where you are now.\
\
Outside the Twilight Forest it only tells you where it works.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** it finds the nearest lair, even one you already cleared. Head past it and search again.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Tip:** Twilight's own [Magic Map](item://twilightforest:magic_map) and [Maze Map](item://twilightforest:maze_map) still work too, and show the area around the lair.

pages.title: No compass needed
pages.text:
The other prize bosses don't hide in a lair you have to find:

- the **Wither** is summoned,
- the **Ender Dragon** waits past the Stronghold portal, and an Eye of Ender finds the Stronghold,
- the **Hullbreaker** roams the Abyssal Chasm biome, which a [Cave Biome Map](item://alexscaves:cave_map) finds.
